description: Create a new SWSD problem (ITIL problem record). Required: `name`. Strongly recommended: `description`, `priority`, `category`. The created problem's id is returned for follow-up calls. Use this when promoting a recurring incident to a problem record so root-cause analysis and known-error tracking can be tied to multiple incidents. WRITE — does not retry on transient failure; the agent should verify with swsd_get_problem before retrying.

assignee_email.description: Email of the agent to assign the problem to.

category.description: Category name (must match an existing SWSD category — see swsd_list_categories).

priority.description: Priority name (e.g. High, Medium, Low). Tenant-specific values.

requester_email.description: Email of the user the problem is for. Defaults to the token owner if omitted.

name: swsd_create_problem
